title: Factory data integration
subtitle: Staging, master-data controls and import history — read-only Factory 360 profiles

banner.title: Settings only.
banner.body: Factory 360 profiles are read-only. Setting up a provider does not prove it's connected. CSV rows stay staged until a separate, approved reconciliation, and source identifiers can't be silently replaced.

provider.title: Senaei provider
provider.noRemoteCall: No remote call is made from this page. Undocumented provider domains remain SENAEI_API_CONTRACT_NOT_SUPPLIED.
provider.help: The endpoint contract and its recorded live-call check are shown in SENAI data management. Setting it up is not the same as being connected.

csv.title: CSV staging and validation
csv.schemaNote: Schema {schema}. Required identity columns: {required}. Files are staged for reconciliation; this action never overwrites factory truth.
csv.staged: Batch {batch} staged: {pending} pending reconciliation, {rejected} rejected with safe row errors. Zero rows are accepted until governed reconciliation.

masterData.title: Factory master-data controls
masterData.help: These operations are always recorded in the Activity Log. They do not edit external CR, license, or plant identifiers.
masterData.noWritebackHelp: Everything saved here is recorded in SAQEEL only. No establishment or factory master-data change is sent to SENAI: the endpoint contract has no master-data write endpoint, so there is no path for one.
